- TOTAL revenue reached £32.7k in TW versus £17.5k in LW, a WoW increase of 86.6%.
- TOTAL units came in at 17,439 in TW, up 184.8% WoW, while TOTAL orders reached 485, up 11.0% WoW.
- WHITE HANGING HEART T-LIGHT HOLDER ranked 1 in TW with £2,963.43, a 9.1% share of TOTAL revenue.
- RETRO SPOT TEA SET CERAMIC 11 PC posted £2,071.74 in TW (6.3% share) and FAWN BLUE HOT WATER BOTTLE £1,903.35 (5.8% share).
- The top 5 products accounted for 32.5% of TOTAL revenue in TW, with PARTY BUNTING at £1,877.24 and PINK CREAM FELT CRAFT TRINKET BOX at £1,785.89.
- Largest WoW gains came from FAWN BLUE HOT WATER BOTTLE at +£1,903.35, RETRO SPOT TEA SET CERAMIC 11 PC at +£1,754.29 and PINK CREAM FELT CRAFT TRINKET BOX at +£1,644.62.
- Largest WoW declines came from REGENCY CAKESTAND 3 TIER at -£2,083.43, PARTY BUNTING at -£640.47 and RED RETROSPOT JUMBO BAG at -£524.52.
- GLITTER HANGING BUTTERFLY STRING rose 4,752.8% WoW and FLAG OF ST GEORGE CAR FLAG rose 3,253.7% WoW.
